notes: Variant WLC.ECC.5.18.v004 is underdetermined and the projection carries r00-base (covers s028, s029); no new textual decision was made (rule 9).
The coordinating 'and' before 'to be comely' was marked added and the second ʾăšer left unrepresented; giving that 'and' to the relative is the competing reading and is noted on the unit.
The marginal alternative rendering and the Hebrew gloss note were read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
The infinitival phrase is the clause's predicate, so 'is for' goes to its lāmed and the supplied subject 'one' with the infinitive marker to the infinitive (rules 49, 48, 52).
